basic_info.description: Perfectly located across from Golden Gate Park, this professionally-managed, well-maintained, 3-unit Edwardian investment property offers the ideal blend of historic charm and modern convenience in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Currently tenant-occupied with strong rental income, the building features three full-floor flexible floorplan flats (currently used as 3/1.25, 2bd/1ba, 3bd/1ba) that showcase beautiful original details including moldings, built-ins, bay windows, and hardwood floors throughout. Each unit includes a full kitchen, family room, living room, and two fireplaces. The top unit features a completely updated kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances, while maintaining its authentic Edwardian character. The spacious, fenced backyard includes a patio and garden. With its prime location near Golden Gate Park's JFK Dr east entrance and only minutes from UCSF, diverse dining/shopping in Cole Valley Village, Haight St, the Sunset and more, only ~4 blocks from Whole Foods, with a 2-car tandem garage and excellent public transportation access, this property offers investors an unbeatable combination of strong rental demand, historic charm, and parkside tranquility in one of SF's most sought-after neighborhoods.
